name: Forward arrow
purpose: The site's only recurring directional glyph — on every primary pill, every team/blog row link, and the newsletter submit.
implementation: inline <svg viewBox="0 0 14 14"> with a single stroked path, strokeWidth 1.3, round caps/joins; currentColor
note: Redeclared locally in 11 different components rather than imported from one place — a real, deliberate duplication in the source, recorded here so a generator does not invent a shared icon module that does not exist.
